newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian dies of wounds sustained in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian dies of wounds sustained in clashes.

text.p: A Palestinian has died of wounds sustained during gun battles with Israeli soldiers last month, Palestinian health ministry officials said on Thursday.
Ramzi al-Ustaz, 21, died in hospital late on Wednesday. The officials said he had been shot in the head.

His death raised to 60 the number of Palestinians killed in clashes that erupted in September after Israel opened a new entrance to an archaeological tunnel near a Moslem shrine in Jerusalem. Palestinians killed 15 Israeli soldiers during the violence.
